description: A standard Flashlight.Can be used to light your way in the darkness. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 8 seconds. "Most of the battery life was wastefully used by the previous owner."

A very portable Flashlight with a good grip.Its efficient technology produces a powerful light while consuming less power. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 8 seconds. Has an increased Aim accuracy of +20 %. Has a reduced Depletion rate of -11 %.

A sturdy but heavy Flashlight that packs a lot of power. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 12 seconds. Has an increased Beam brightness of +30 %. Has an increased Blindness duration of +15 %. Has a reduced Aim accuracy of -20 %.

The bow and shank of a key, vibrating with remnant power.The Broken Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 10 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with.

A bent and dull Key that once held great power.The Dull Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 5 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with. Press the Use Item button while standing over the closed Hatch to open it. This action will consume the Key and is only available if it is not depleted.

A tarnished and crooked Key, vibrating with ominous power.The Skeleton Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 30 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with. Press the Use Item button while standing over the closed Hatch to open it. This action will consume the Key and is only available if it is not depleted.

An old piece of parchment made out of a skin-like material that is rolled and sealed with an uncoloured leather string. Holding and channelling the Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 1 Generator at the start of the Trial. Tracks any other Generator when coming within 8 metres. Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. The Map has 20 Charges.

An piece of parchment made out of oddly fresh skin with blood on its edge that has yet to dry, and that is rolled and sealed with multiple coloured ropes and cords. Holding and channelling the Rainbow Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 3 random objects at the start of the Trial. Tracks the following objects when coming within 8 metres: Exit Gate Switches Generators Hatch Hooks Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. The Rainbow Map has 20 Charges. "It disheartens me. All this unspeakable knowledge and gruelling effort and yet nothing tangible, nothing usable to get out of this nightmare." — Vigo's Journal

A bloodstained piece of parchment, hastily rolled and burning with a strange power. Holding and channelling the Bloodsense Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 3 random objects at the start of the Trial. Tracks the following objects when coming within 8 metres: Exit Gate Switches Generators Hatch Hooks Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. Grants the ability to reveal the Auras of injured Survivors exclusively to yourself.. Causes Pools of Blood to spawn beneath you while being used. The Bloodsense Map has 20 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A rudimentary First Aid Kit which can save lives in emergencies, even if it's lacking some of its supplies.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +35 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Camping Aid Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "Barely has enough material for a decent patch-up."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A standard First Aid Kit with all the necessary equipment for treating common to more serious injuries.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +40 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The First Aid Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A sturdy and well organised Med-Kit equipped with top condition emergency supplies.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +45 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Emergency Med-Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "There is a cure for almost everything...but not for this."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A large metal box containing medical supplies aimed at emergency rescues in hard to reach, often isolated locations.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +50 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Ranger Med-Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "A small engraved label can be found glued to the back panel: VK.ID-3994723."

A metal box containing out of condition tools that could break at any moment.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Reduces the Success zone of Good Skill Checks by -10 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. "You call these tools? ... Really?"

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0Metal box containing a set of basic tools.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 20 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +15 %. "It is unclear as to where these tools come from. Were they brought in by one of us or did they belong to one of the monsters?"

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A large metal box containing basic tool and extra mechanical parts.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 32 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +50 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box with specialised mechanics tools.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +75 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +25 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box containing mainly saws and vice grips of varying sizes but also other tools.Even though the content of this Toolbox is clearly aimed at destructive deeds, it can be used to repair various mechanical components as well. 18 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +10 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +100 %. "Most of the tools are identified as 'owned by Alex'."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box with highly specialised tools meant for engineering.Most of the tools can be used by neophytes to make quick repairs or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +100 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +10 %. "I've created tools beyond compare and stood paralysed as they were stolen from me. These are but a poor replica, spat out by The Fog." — Vigo's Journal

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A Toolbox packed to the brim with fireworks, it is prepared to celebrate all your life's successes... and failures. 32 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +50 %. Succeeding a Great Skill Check detonates a small cluster of firecrackers. Missing a Skill Check detonates fireworks. The Festive Toolbox is only available during Spring Events.
